Author: kaldigo
Name: Accord RSR Test
Description: Separate experimental Accord client with isolated settings and /accordtest. Starts disabled each session. Runs the native RSR baseline and observes its existing selectors; redesigned hotbar buttons and automation policies are not yet implemented. Does not replace stable Accord or migrate its settings.
Punchline: Opt-in workbench for the RSR-based Accord redesign.
Changelog: Initial opt-in native RSR baseline and cached selector workbench. Native acceptance pending; redesigned intent execution is not implemented.

Author: The Combat Reborn Team; Accord experiment maintained by kaldigo
Name: Rotation Solver Reborn - Accord Test
Description: Isolated RSR fork for the opt-in Accord redesign. Requires an active Accord RSR Test session. Disable stock RSR before loading; disable stable Accord and Wrath before starting a session. Native RSR baseline and selector observation only; redesigned intent buttons are not implemented yet.
Punchline: Opt-in RSR engine for Accord testing.
Changelog: Initial opt-in native RSR baseline and cached selector workbench. Native acceptance pending; redesigned intent execution is not implemented.
